fields.label: General
fields.summary: Relevant contributions, deliverables, scope, and supported outcomes.
fields.priorities: Evaluate contributions, deliverables, responsibilities, methods, scope, and outcomes against this posting. Relevant nonnumeric evidence is valid.
fields.cautions: Do not infer a specialty or professional authority from the candidate's field or a keyword.

fields.label: Software & Data
fields.summary: Implementation, evaluation, reliability, and documented technical impact.
fields.priorities: Emphasize implementation, evaluation, reliability, data analysis, and technical impact where relevant to the posting and documented by the source.
fields.cautions: A prototype is not a production deployment; evaluation is not an improvement unless the source states the comparison. The employer's industry does not change the candidate's field.

fields.label: Finance & Consulting
fields.summary: Analysis, valuation, research, recommendations, and decision support.
fields.priorities: Emphasize analysis, financial modeling, valuation, research, reporting, recommendations, and decision support only where documented and relevant to this role. Distinguish FP&A, investment banking, and consulting needs using the posting.
fields.cautions: Analyzed assets are not managed assets; forecasts are not realized results; recommendations are not implemented decisions. Academic cases and simulated portfolios are not professional advisory or investment authority.

fields.label: Accounting
fields.summary: Reconciliation, reporting, controls, and documented accuracy.
fields.priorities: Emphasize reconciliation, accounting analysis, reporting, controls, documentation, and accuracy where supported and relevant to the posting.
fields.cautions: Do not infer audit sign-off, regulatory compliance, professional certification, or authority to approve accounts from preparing or reviewing supporting material.

fields.label: Marketing
fields.summary: Audience research, campaigns, channels, and measured results.
fields.priorities: Emphasize audience research, campaign execution, content, channel analysis, and measured engagement or conversion where supported and relevant to the posting.
fields.cautions: Reach and engagement are not sales or conversion; campaign participation is not strategy ownership. Do not infer attribution or causal business impact.

fields.label: Operations & Supply Chain
fields.summary: Planning, processes, inventory, service, and documented efficiency.
fields.priorities: Emphasize planning, process execution, inventory, logistics, service, coordination, and efficiency where supported and relevant to this posting.
fields.cautions: Tracking or coordinating a process is not owning its budget or approving procurement. Do not infer savings, throughput improvements, or service-level compliance.
